# Checklist of Owed Checks

[中文](checks-owed.md) · **English** · [日本語](checks-owed.ja.md)

<!-- doc-lint:not-numbers J10 KM7 L7 LR5 N5 N7 T2 T3 T4 -->

**`checks-owed.md` tracks checks where we know what to prevent, but cannot enforce yet.**

Boundary with [crates/singlefs-checker/invariants/](../../crates/singlefs-checker/invariants/README.md): Invariants are properties decidable against a single disk image,
and checker is their executable form; `checks-owed.md` contains **requirements on execution paths**—
they cannot be determined by inspecting an image alone, and can only be caught at runtime by gates.

**Bar for entry**: Must be able to state "what to prevent", "how to catch (the form that turns red)", and "what preconditions are missing".
Missing any of the three means the requirement is not yet clearly thought through; do not add it yet
(`.claude/singlefs-ai-sop/rules/sop-first.md`: if you cannot specify the next step, do not add that check).

**Status**: All entries in the checklist of owed checks remain unimplemented. Entries prefixed with "model layer paid", "half paid", "decision settled, check still owed", or "preconditions paid" have discharged only part of the requirement; the rest is still owed.
(C1 (intent resumption made the regular path) is fully paid and is in the paid-off table.) The unlink cell of C2 (unbounded operation made into single transaction) already has a slope check; the other two cells await the truncate and directory-deletion operations to be judged (transaction-layer and block-layer write recording have long existed, but inspection currently finds zero code for file-level truncate and directory deletion).
C6 (Wrong Block Layer Semantic Assumptions Written) awaits reconstruction of crash states from the VM's device-side log (C5 (Z3 timeout treated as pass) is fully paid and is in the paid-off table).
C7 (no check for stale blocks) awaits a custom device model (the Merkle half already exists); C9 (covertly modifying format after freeze) / C10 (Historical unit formats unreadable) await the first freeze.
**Half of the prerequisites for C8 (Gate Scope Cannot Be Determined) are still outstanding**: the layout registry came with C14 (`.claude/gate.d/layouts.tsv`), but C8 (Gate Scope Cannot Be Determined) still needs directory conventions distinguishing exclusive paths from shared paths. After C20 (Rare Layouts Nobody Runs) was merged into C635 (No machine-readable marker for the last full run), the timestamp for "the last complete run" is owed under that entry.

Entries that are fully settled move to the "Settled" section, preserving their number, short name, and resolution—
numbers are retained because other documents, gate scripts, and history changelogs cite them; deleting numbers creates dangling references.
The open table contains no settled rows (a cell beginning with 「已还（…）」 (paid) or 「销账」 (written off)), and must not be broken by empty lines; both are enforced by the table-shape cell of doc-registries gate.
